title: SEC3: assign_devid missing _ctx suffix for CTX variant
description: wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(WOLFSSL_CTX*) and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl(WOLFSSL*) are inconsistently named. wolfSSL's own API uses CTX/SSL suffix symmetry (wolfSSL_CTX_SetDevId vs wolfSSL_SetDevId). The bare 'assign_devid' name gives no indication it takes a CTX argument; a reader expecting consistency would guess _ctx and _ssl as the two variants. Rename to wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ctx to match the wolfSSL convention and make the pairing explicit in the header.
